g.text: Matrix: green = mean-Hessian ruled lower E2 than P1; copper = higher E2; grey = exact tie.
The mean Hessian is analytic; local directions vary. There is no universal advantage over P2 triangles or real DTM.
Fixed finite candidate grids, not global optimization. P1 follows L2 greedy region priority / L1 bisection-edge choice; no C0 closure.
Independent seven-node whole-domain integrals and saved native polynomial query checks; not ArcGIS/author-original execution, timing or RAM.
